descriptions.preferred: Asahi means "the dawn" or "rising sun" and zuru means "swan." Hence, the name of this cultivar can be interpreted as "the dawn swan." 'Asahi zuru' is among the dependable cultivars with sharply defined and clear variegation. The white portions have distinct and sharp margins, and the green portions are a rich green. The leaves vary considerably in markings on each plant. Some, especially the smaller leaves, are almost entirely white, while others are almost completely green with only one small patch of white. Some leaves have only minute flecks of white or pink. Solid green leaves occur Corvallis shaped lobes when containing white sections. The petioles range up to 6 cm long and vary from pink on some leaves to green on the normal-colored leaves. Twigs and small branches are dark green and do not have the pink striping often present in the similar

rhs.description: A variegated, upright, spreading, large shrub or small tree to 4m tall with green leaves variously blotched with white and pink, sometimes appearing entirely white or pink, turning red in autumn

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、建筑式景观、岩石园、露台/容器植物、低维护

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 斑叶型、大型灌木或小乔木，生长直立而开展，株高可达 4 米；叶片绿色，其上不规则覆有白色和粉色斑块，有时整叶几乎呈白色或粉色；秋季转红。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖

descriptions_zh.preferred: Asahi 意为“晨曦”或“朝阳”，zuru 意为“天鹅”。因此，这个品种名可理解为“晨曦之鹅”。'Asahi zuru' 是斑叶表现稳定可靠的品种之一，斑纹界线清晰鲜明。白色部分边缘分明锐利，绿色部分则为浓绿。每株植株上叶片的斑纹变化很大。有些叶片，尤其较小的叶片，几乎通体白色；而另一些则几乎全绿，仅带一小块白斑。有些叶片只带有极细小的白色或粉色斑点。也会出现全绿色叶片。带白色斑块的叶片裂片形态通常较为典型。叶柄最长可达 6 厘米，颜色因叶而异，有些为粉色，正常色叶片则为绿色。小枝和细枝为深绿色，不具有与其相似品种 'Oridono nishiki' 常见的粉色条纹。该树虽为直立型，但树冠开展、呈圆头状，幼龄时期生长较快；随着树龄增加，生长速度减缓，株形也更紧凑。可高达 8 米，冠幅 3-4 米。多干丛生植株观赏效果尤为出众。新梢有时起初表现为典型的 palmatum 型，但木质部达到两年生及以上时，斑叶特征会发展得更好。该品种耐寒，适合多种园林景观应用。与所有斑叶品种一样，下午适当遮阴有助于防止叶片过度焦边。'Asahi zuru' 也曾以别名
